title: Replace a recreational fishing licence (1-year or 3-year)
summary: This page provides instructions on how to apply for a replacement recreational fishing licence receipt if your plastic card is lost, damaged, or stolen.
intro:
A NSW recreational fishing fee receipt (licence) can be either:

You must always have your receipt with you when you fish.

If your plastic receipt has been lost, damaged or stolen, you can apply for a replacement online.

You will need to pay a processing fee to replace a plastic card.

For a list of fees go to recreational fishing fees. For information on fishing in NSW go to NSW Primary Industries website.
who_can_apply: Must be a recreational fisher in NSW.
what_you_need: The name and licence number (found on your NSW fishing fee receipt).
Payment for a processing fee (if replacing a plastic card).

how_to_steps.text: Enter your name and your licence number. You can find this number on your NSW fishing fee receipt.
Follow the prompts to apply for your replacement fishing licence/fee receipt.

faqs.q: Do I need to carry my fishing licence when I fish?
faqs.a: Yes, you must always have your receipt with you when you fish.

faqs.q: How do I replace a lost or damaged fishing licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a replacement online if your plastic receipt has been lost, damaged, or stolen.

faqs.q: What is required to replace a plastic fishing licence card?
faqs.a: You will need to pay a processing fee to replace a plastic card.
